question: Use `test/qa/lane_du_suite_probe_test.py`, class `TestLaneDuSuiteProbeQA`, method `test_lane_du_suite_probe_cases`, and execute the full parametrized suite in that file (all cases). Tracing records call, line, and return for `yt_dlp/bind_lane.py::tube_digest` during those runs. For one completed call, process line events in order and build dynamic def-use triples (var, def_lineno, use_lineno) for locals and parameters of tube_digest: initialize last_def[v] to the function def line for each parameter v; at each executed line L, for each variable read on L in the source, if last_def has v, record (v, last_def[v], L); then for each variable written on L, set last_def[v] = L (uses before defs on the same line). Let U be the set of all distinct triples from all calls in the suite. Let R be the union of triple sets from the same rule applied to tube_digest run in isolation on inputs (0, ""), (1, "x"), (2, "x"), (0, "ab"), (1, "ab") in that order, using the same yt_dlp/bind_lane.py. Return all_du_pairs_covered true iff every triple in R appears at least once in U. Return missing_du_pairs as the list of triples in R but not in U, each as [var, def_lineno, use_lineno] sorted lexicographically by (var, def_lineno, use_lineno), or [] if all_du_pairs_covered is true.
